dedupe_keys.name: plantoact task 2 1 hourly profiles wind power

description: Matteo Giacomo Prina and Valentina D’Alonzo publish normalised hourly wind profiles for Lombardia, Alba County, Oberland, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes and metropolitan Porto. The source describes Renewables.ninja time series at MERRA-2 grid points for 2020–2024, regional aggregation and a nonlinear correction of the 2024 profile to preserve long-term equivalent full-load hours. Outputs include standard 8,760-hour and leap-year 8,784-hour profiles, intermediate aggregation and full-load-hour comparisons. Values are dimensionless; the source explains that annual generation reconstruction requires the regional maximum capacity factor. The data support regional energy-system planning. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that these are corrected model-derived profiles, not direct generation measurements or forecasts for a specific future year. Related PLANtoACT solar and hydro profiles represent other technologies. No profile values, generation code or image files were fetched.
